CFML Language Reference: Functions

ListContainsNoCase

Returns the position of the first element of a list that contains the given text anywhere inside it, without regard to upper or lower case. If no element contains the text, the result is 0.

Category

List functions

Syntax

ListContainsNoCase(list, substring [, delimiters ])

Parameters

list
The list to search.
substring
The text to look for inside each element.
delimiters
Optional. The delimiter characters of the list; the default is a comma.

Returns

The index of the first matching element, or 0.

Usage

Use ListContains for a case-sensitive search and ListFindNoCase to match whole elements only.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFQUERY NAME="GetParks" DATASOURCE="cfsnippets">
SELECT ParkName FROM Parks WHERE Region = 'Pacific West'
</CFQUERY>
<CFSET ParkList = ValueList(GetParks.ParkName)>
<CFPARAM NAME="URL.Word" DEFAULT="SEASHORE">
<CFSET Pos = ListContainsNoCase(ParkList, URL.Word)>
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>Parks in the Pacific West region: #ListLen(ParkList)#</P>
<CFIF Pos>
  <P>The first park whose name contains "#URL.Word#" is number #Pos#:
  <B>#ListGetAt(ParkList, Pos)#</B></P>
<CFELSE>
  <P>No Pacific West park name contains "#URL.Word#".</P>
</CFIF>
<FORM ACTION="listcontainsnocase.cfm" METHOD="get">
Search for: <INPUT TYPE="text" NAME="Word" VALUE="#HTMLEditFormat(URL.Word)#">
<INPUT TYPE="submit" VALUE="Search">
</FORM>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

ListContains, ListFindNoCase, FindNoCase, ValueList
